info.title: Taleed API
info.description:
The API of the Taleed mobile apps.

Read docs/mobile/api-guide.md in the Taleed repository before integrating. In short:

- Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <token>` from `POST /auth/sign-in` or `POST /auth/sign-up`.
- Send `Accept-Language` (`fr`, `ar` or `en`), `X-App-Platform` (`ios` or `android`) and `X-App-Version` on every request.
- Errors always have the `ApiError` shape; switch on `error.code`.
- Amounts are integer Algerian dinars. Dates are ISO 8601 in UTC. URLs are absolute.
- In request bodies, a field set to null counts as left out.
- Lists are paginated with opaque cursors: pass `nextCursor` back as `cursor`.
- Requests are rate-limited: 300 per minute per member; without a session, and on endpoints that take none, 1200 per minute per network address. Some endpoints have a tighter limit of their own. Over a limit: `429 rate_limited`, with `Retry-After` in seconds.
- v1 only changes in backward-compatible ways: ignore unknown fields and accept unknown enum values.

post.description:
Deletes the account for good, as App Store guideline 5.1.1(v) requires the apps to offer. Personal details, the profile photo, listings nobody ordered, saved addresses, favorites, follows and ID documents are erased; orders, reviews and messages stay with the other members, under a deleted account. It is refused while something is in progress: `orders_in_progress`, `dispute_in_progress`, `payout_in_progress`, or `wallet_not_empty` when the balance must be withdrawn first. Admin accounts are deleted by the team (`forbidden`). A suspended member can delete their account too, as on the website. A wrong password answers `wrong_password`; 5 attempts in 15 minutes, `rate_limited`. On success every session ends, this one too: sign out locally. A POST rather than a DELETE because the password travels in the body.

Requires a bearer token.

The buyer's offer, from the listing screen: it opens the conversation with the seller if needed. One negotiation at a time: while an offer waits for an answer in the conversation, another one is `offer_pending`. The other member gets a notification and a push. An offer on your own listing is `forbidden`; one on an item no longer for sale is `listing_unavailable`.

Requires a bearer token.

Rate limit: 60 per hour per member, on top of the general limit.

subtotal.description: Sum of the prices of the items still for sale. Offers on the bundle are bounded on it. Integer DZD.

acceptedOffer.description: An offer on the bundle the seller accepted, not used by an order yet: its amount replaces `subtotal`, and checkout applies it.

itemsTotal.description: What the items cost: the accepted offer's amount, or `subtotal`. Integer DZD.

protectionFee.description: Platform and service fee on `itemsTotal`, charged once for the bundle. Integer DZD.

shippingFrom.description: Null when the buyer has no wilaya on their profile, nothing is for sale, or no quote could be made: show "calculated at checkout".

total.description: `itemsTotal` + `protectionFee` + `shippingFrom`: an estimate of what checkout charges. Integer DZD.

offerRange.description: Bounds of an offer on the bundle (`POST /bundles/{id}/offers`). Null when no offer can be made.

canBuy.description: Show "Buy", "Make an offer" and "Ask the seller": the bundle is `OPEN`, holds items still for sale, and neither member blocked the other. "Buy" opens checkout with `bundleId` (`POST /checkout/quote`, then `POST /orders`).

BundleReview.description: A buyer's bundle, as the review screen shows it: several items from one seller, bought as one parcel.

listingIds.description: The items, in the order the buyer picked them, 20 at most. Can be empty, to clear the bundle.

BundleSelection.description: What the buyer picked in a seller's wardrobe.

status.description: The carrier's own words, usually in French, such as "Livré". Show them as they are. `CREATED`, the oldest, marks the label being made.

place.description: Where the carrier scanned the parcel: an agency, a wilaya.

at.description: When the carrier recorded it. ISO 8601, UTC.

CarrierEvent.description: A scan of the parcel, as the carrier reports it.

total.description: Everything the recipient hands the carrier: the order total, less what the wallet paid. Integer Algerian dinars (DZD).

deliveryFee.description: The carrier's delivery fee inside `total`, which the carrier keeps. 0 when the platform pays the carrier instead (a free-delivery code, or a discount that covered part of the delivery). Integer Algerian dinars (DZD).

CashOnDelivery.description: What the carrier collects in cash when it delivers a cash-on-delivery order.

reportReasons.description: The reasons of the report form, in display order.

disputeReasons.description: The reasons of the dispute form, in display order.

payoutMethods.description: The payout form's methods, in display order.

Catalog.description: Reference data for browsing, filtering, reporting, disputes and payouts, localized. Cache it; it changes rarely.

children.description: Subcategories, in display order. Listings are filed under these.

CategoryNode.description: A top-level category and its subcategories.

slug.description: Stable identifier used in filters (`category=`) and website URLs.

itemPrice.description: The items, at the offer's price if any. Integer DZD.

protectionFee.description: Platform and service fee. Integer DZD.

shippingFee.description: Delivery, for the delivery type picked. Integer DZD.

promoDiscount.description: Taken off by the promo code. Integer DZD.

voucherDiscount.description: Taken off by the member's referral voucher, which applies on its own: what it adds to the promo code. Integer DZD.

total.description: What the order costs: `subtotal` − `discount`. Send it back as `expectedTotal`. Integer DZD.

walletApplied.description: Paid from the wallet balance, with `useWallet`. Integer DZD.

amountDue.description: What is left to pay, online or in cash: `total` − `walletApplied`. 0 when the wallet pays it all. Integer DZD.

freeDelivery.description: A free-delivery promo code applies: show the delivery as free.

CheckoutAmounts.description: Every amount of the checkout, as the server computes them. Show them as they are.

communeId.description: From `GET /wilayas/{id}/communes`, or a saved address's `communeId`. Required to order, except for a stopdesk that has its own `communeId`. A quote without it gives the wilaya's highest fees (`fees.exact` false).

addressLine.description: `HOME`: street, building, floor, 200 characters at most. Required to order.

CheckoutDelivery.description: Where the parcel goes. An address the server cannot use is an `invalid_request` pointing at the field (`body.delivery.communeId`…): a commune or a stopdesk outside the wilaya, or one the carrier no longer serves.

addressLine.description: `HOME`: the street address. `STOPDESK`: the desk's address.

CheckoutDestination.description: Where the parcel goes, as the server read it.

stopdesk.description: Pick-up at a stopdesk. Integer DZD.

exact.description: The fees of the commune picked. False without a commune: the wilaya's highest, which picking the commune can lower.

CheckoutFees.description: The carrier's fee for each delivery type, for the delivery picker.

listingId.description: The listing, or the bundle's first item still for sale.

title.description: The item's title, or "Bundle · 3 items", in the response language.

items.description: What the parcel will hold. For a bundle, its items still for sale: those sold since it was saved are left out.

listedPrice.description: The items' prices added up. Integer DZD.

offer.description: The accepted offer the price comes from.

itemPrice.description: What the items cost: the offer's amount, or `listedPrice`. Integer DZD.

CheckoutGoods.description: What is bought, at which price.

promoError.description: The promo code sent cannot be used: show `message` under the field. The rest of the quote leaves it out, and ordering with it is `promo_invalid`.

walletBalance.description: The member's wallet balance, for "Use my balance". 0: hide the option. Integer DZD.

paymentMethods.description: The ways to pay offered right now, in display order.

paymentMethod.description: How `amountDue` would be paid: the `paymentMethod` sent, or the first one offered. Null when nothing is left to pay.

cashOnDelivery.description: Paying cash on delivery: what the carrier will collect.

CheckoutQuote.description: What the checkout costs with these details. Nothing is reserved yet.

listingId.description: The listing to buy. Send it or `bundleId`.

bundleId.description: The signed-in member's bundle to buy (`GET /bundles/{id}`): one parcel for its items still for sale.

offerId.description: The accepted offer to buy at: `acceptedOffer` of the listing or the bundle, or the offer of a conversation's "Pay now". Without it, the latest accepted offer still usable applies anyway. One that can no longer be used is ignored.

promoCode.description: A promo code the member typed. Case and spaces do not matter.

useWallet.description: Pay with the wallet balance first. Default false.

paymentMethod.description: How to pay what is left: one of the quote's `paymentMethods`. Default: the first of them.

CheckoutQuoteRequest.description: What the member is about to order. The commune, street and desk can still be missing.

name.description: As the carrier spells it, in French whatever the response language: addresses and parcel labels use this spelling.

label.description: The full label, for the listing screen, the sell form and filters.

shortLabel.description: The short label listing cards show in their condition chip, such as "Neuf, étiqueté" or "Très bon".

counterpart.description: The other member. Null when they deleted their account: show "Deleted member".

listing.description: Null on official threads, which are about no listing.

isOfficial.description: An announcement thread from the official Taleed account: members only read it.

unreadCount.description: Messages from the other member the signed-in member has not read.

lastMessageAt.description: Last activity: the inbox is sorted on it, newest first. ISO 8601, UTC.

canReply.description: Show the composer. When false, show `replyDisabledReason` in its place: messages stay readable.

isBlocked.description: The signed-in member blocked the other member: offer "Unblock" (`DELETE /members/{username}/block`).

offerRange.description: Bounds of an offer made from the conversation (`POST /conversations/{id}/offers`): the buyer's offer, or the seller's proposed price. Null when none can be made: replies are closed, the item is not for sale, or an offer already waits for an answer.

pendingOffer.description: The offer waiting for an answer, whoever made it.

Conversation.description: A conversation, as its screen shows it.

ConversationListing.description: The listing a conversation is about.

buyerId.description: For the seller only: the member to write to about their listing, for example someone who favorited it. Leave it out to write to the seller as a buyer.

ConversationOpen.description: The conversation to open: about a listing, between its seller and a buyer.

counterpart.description: The other member. Null when they deleted their account: show "Deleted member".

listing.description: Null on official threads, which are about no listing.

isOfficial.description: An announcement thread from the official Taleed account: members only read it.

unreadCount.description: Messages from the other member the signed-in member has not read.

lastMessageAt.description: Last activity: the inbox is sorted on it, newest first. ISO 8601, UTC.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page. Null on the last page.

total.description: Number of items across all pages.

ConversationSummaryPage.description: A page of the inbox, most recent activity first.

DeliveryType.description: `HOME`: the carrier delivers to the buyer's address. `STOPDESK`: the buyer collects the parcel at a carrier pick-up point, with an ID.

token.description: The Firebase Cloud Messaging registration token of this installation.

locale.description: Language of the pushes: the app's language. Defaults to the request's `Accept-Language`.

DeviceRegistration.description: This app installation, to send it push notifications.

sellerDeadlineAt.description: While `OPEN`: the seller has until then to accept or contest the claim, after which the Taleed team mediates. Tell the seller the dispute waits for them, the buyer that it waits for the seller. ISO 8601, UTC.

resolution.description: Once resolved, how, in words: the seller accepted the claim, or the Taleed team's decision as they wrote it.

description.description: The buyer's account of the problem, written when opening the dispute. It is also the first message of the thread.

canPost.description: The thread takes messages (`POST /disputes/{id}/messages`): until the dispute is resolved.

canRespond.description: The signed-in member is the seller and the claim waits for their answer: show "Accept the claim" and "Contest" (`POST /disputes/{id}/respond`).

messages.description: The whole thread, oldest first. The buyer, the seller and Taleed support see every message and every photo.

createdAt.description: When the buyer opened it. ISO 8601, UTC.

resolvedAt.description: When it was resolved. ISO 8601, UTC.

DisputeAnswer.description: `ACCEPT`: the buyer is refunded in full, at once — the fastest way to settle a dispute. `CONTEST`: the Taleed team mediates.

DisputeAuthorRole.description: Who wrote in a dispute thread: the order's buyer or seller, or the Taleed support team.

DisputeCreate.description: The buyer's claim. Every reason but `NOT_RECEIVED` needs at least one photo (`needsEvidence` in `GET /catalog`): of the defect, the packaging or the parcel label.

authorName.description: The author's @handle. Null when they deleted their account.

body.description: Plain text. Empty when the message is photos only.

createdAt.description: When it was posted. ISO 8601, UTC.

DisputeMessage.description: A message of a dispute thread.

body.description: Plain text, 2000 characters at most. Optional with photos.

DisputeMessageCreate.description: A message in a dispute thread: some text, photos, or both.

DisputeReason.description: What went wrong with an order. Localized labels, and which reasons need photo evidence, come from `GET /catalog`.

needsEvidence.description: The dispute form must hold at least one photo for this reason: of the defect, the packaging or the parcel label. `NOT_RECEIVED` needs none: the tracking is the evidence.

DisputeResponse.description: The seller's answer to the buyer's claim.

DisputeStatus.description: `OPEN`: waiting for the seller's answer until `sellerDeadlineAt`. `UNDER_REVIEW`: the Taleed team mediates (the seller contested, or let the deadline pass). `RESOLVED_REFUND`: the buyer was refunded. `RESOLVED_RELEASE`: the seller was paid. Each dispute carries its localized label (`statusLabel`).

sellerDeadlineAt.description: While `OPEN`: the seller has until then to accept or contest the claim, after which the Taleed team mediates. Tell the seller the dispute waits for them, the buyer that it waits for the seller. ISO 8601, UTC.

resolution.description: Once resolved, how, in words: the seller accepted the claim, or the Taleed team's decision as they wrote it.

DisputeSummary.description: The dispute on an order, as the order screen shows it: the payment stays frozen until it is resolved.

ErrorCode.description: Machine-readable error code. Apps show their own localized message for it; `message` is for developers and logs. New codes can appear: handle an unknown code by its HTTP status.

message.description: Developer-facing explanation, in English. Never show it as-is.

issues.description: Present on `invalid_request`: every invalid field. Also on the few errors about one field (`offer_out_of_range`, `promo_invalid`, `payment_method_unavailable`), pointing at it.

detail.description: Present on `carrier_error`: the carrier's own explanation, in its language (usually French), such as a phone number it refuses. Show it under your message: it tells the seller what to fix.

retryAfter.description: Present on `rate_limited`: seconds to wait before the same request can pass. The `Retry-After` header carries it too.

orderId.description: Present on `listing_unavailable` from checkout when the goods are reserved by the member's own order awaiting payment: open that order (`GET /orders/{id}`) to pay or cancel it, as the website does, instead of saying the item is gone.

path.description: Where the problem is: `body.email`, `query.cursor`, `path.id`. Use it to highlight the field.

ErrorIssue.description: One invalid field of an `invalid_request` error.

FavoriteState.description: The heart button after the change.

FollowState.description: The follow button and the member's follower count after the change.

documentKey.description: A key from `POST /uploads?purpose=id_document`: the readable front side of an ID card or a passport.

rejectionNote.description: With `REJECTED`: why, as the reviewer wrote it (usually in French). Null otherwise, and when the reviewer gave no reason.

IdentityVerification.description: Where the member's identity verification stands.

slug.description: Null when the seller typed a brand that is not in the catalog: display only, not filterable.

price.description: Item price, before the buyer's platform and service fee. Integer Algerian dinars (DZD).

size.description: Free text written by the seller: "M", "42", "6 mois".

isFavorited.description: Favorited by the signed-in member. Always false when signed out.

isBoosted.description: Promoted by the seller: show the boosted badge.

ListingCard.description: A listing in a grid or a list.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page. Null on the last page.

total.description: Number of items across all pages.

ListingCategory.description: The category a listing is filed under, with its parent for breadcrumbs.

ListingCondition.description: Condition of an item. Localized labels come from `GET /catalog`.

categoryId.description: A subcategory: `categories[].children[].id` from `GET /catalog`. Listings are never filed under a top-level category.

brand.description: Leave it out, or send `{}`, for no brand.

size.description: Free text: "M", "42", "6 mois". An empty string means no size.

wilayaId.description: Wilaya the item ships from. Leave it out to use the seller's wilaya.

photos.description: In display order; the first one is the cover.

ListingCreate.description: A new listing. It goes on sale immediately.

protectionFee.description: Platform and service fee the buyer pays on top of `price`, for display next to it. Checkout returns the exact total. Integer DZD.

photos.description: In display order; the first one is the cover.

isOwner.description: The signed-in member is the seller: show the owner actions instead of buying.

acceptedOffer.description: Buy at this price: pass its `id` as `offerId` at checkout.

canBuy.description: Show "Buy" (`POST /checkout/quote`, then `POST /orders`): the item is for sale, it is not the member's own, and neither member blocked the other. True when signed out: ask the member to sign in first.

orderId.description: `RESERVED` or `SOLD`: the order of this item the signed-in member is the buyer or the seller of. Show "View the order" (`GET /orders/{id}`) instead of buying.

offerRange.description: Show "Make an offer" (`POST /listings/{id}/offers`), within these bounds. Null when no offer can be made: the item is not for sale, it is the member's own, or one of the two members blocked the other. Signed out, ask the member to sign in first.

canMessage.description: Show "Message the seller" (`POST /conversations`): the item is for sale, it is not the member's own, and neither member blocked the other. True when signed out: ask the member to sign in first.

canBundle.description: Show the "shop a bundle" entry point: the seller has at least two items for sale, the viewer is not the seller, and neither member blocked the other.

openBundleId.description: The signed-in member's bundle with this seller, still to check out (`GET /bundles/{id}`), as the seller profile's `openBundleId`. Null when signed out, for the seller, or when there is none.

inMyBundle.description: This listing is an item of `openBundleId`: the bundle toggle reads "Remove from the bundle" instead of "Add to the bundle". Change the selection with `PUT /members/{username}/bundle`, sending the whole list. Always false when signed out and for the seller.

memberItems.description: Up to 5 other items for sale by the same seller.

similar.description: Up to 5 recent items from the same category.

shareUrl.description: Public website URL of the listing, for the share sheet.

username.description: Handle without the @, used in `/members/{username}`. Null only for a few accounts older than usernames: they have no profile page.

displayName.description: What to show for this member: `@username`. Members' real names are never shown to other members.

isVerified.description: Identity verified by Taleed: show the verified badge.

isOfficial.description: The official Taleed account: show the official badge instead of the verified one.

lastSeenAt.description: Last activity on the website or the apps, precise to about 5 minutes. Null if never seen. ISO 8601, UTC.

ListingSort.description: Order of search results. `recommended` (the default) is personalized for a signed-in member. Localized labels come from `GET /catalog`.

ListingStatus.description: `ACTIVE` can be bought. `RESERVED` has an order in progress, `SOLD` is sold. `HIDDEN` (paused by the seller) and `DRAFT` are only ever returned to the seller.

status.description: `HIDDEN` pauses the listing: only the seller sees it. `ACTIVE` puts it back on sale.

categoryId.description: A subcategory: `categories[].children[].id` from `GET /catalog`. Listings are never filed under a top-level category.

size.description: Free text: "M", "42", "6 mois". An empty string means no size.

isVerified.description: Identity verified by Taleed: show the verified badge.

isOfficial.description: The official Taleed account: show the official badge instead of the verified one.

email.description: Signs in with it. After `POST /me/email`, it changes once the member opens the link sent to the new address.

emailVerified.description: False until the member clicks the link in the verification email.

name.description: Legal name (first and family name). Private: only ever shown to the member themselves. Frozen once the identity is verified (`isVerified`): it is the name on the ID.

firstName.description: The first word of `name`, as the profile form edits it.

lastName.description: The rest of `name`. Empty for a name of one word.

usernameNextChangeAt.description: When the username can change again: renames are spaced out. Null: it can change now. ISO 8601, UTC.

unreadMessages.description: Unread messages across all conversations: the inbox badge.

checks.description: The verified-information list: which facts Taleed has confirmed.

isMe.description: This is the signed-in member's own profile.

isFollowing.description: The signed-in member follows this member. Always false when signed out.

isBlocked.description: The signed-in member blocked this member: offer "Unblock" (`DELETE /members/{username}/block`) instead of following or writing. Always false when signed out.

canBundle.description: Show the "shop a bundle" entry point: at least two items for sale, not the member's own profile, and neither member blocked the other.

openBundleId.description: The signed-in member's bundle with this seller, still to check out (`GET /bundles/{id}`): preselect its items when they shop a bundle again. Null when signed out or when there is none.

total.description: Items shown on the profile: for sale, reserved and sold.

categories.description: The categories the member sells in, for the wardrobe filter, alphabetical by name then parent.

isOfficial.description: The official Taleed account: show the official badge instead of the verified one.

senderId.description: The member who sent it. On automatic messages, the member whose action produced it.

createdAt.description: When it was sent. ISO 8601, UTC.

text.description: `TEXT`: the words, plain text, null for a photo alone. Pills (`OFFER_UPDATE`, `ORDER_UPDATE`, `SYSTEM`): their text, in the response language. Null otherwise.

html.description: Official announcements only: the message as sanitized HTML (paragraphs, lists, links, images), to show instead of `text`, which holds its plain-text version.

photoUrl.description: A photo sent with a `TEXT` message.

url.description: A website address: route it like a universal link.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page. Null on the last page.

total.description: Number of items across all pages.

text.description: One line for the inbox, in the response language: the message, or what it is ("📷 Photo", "Offer · 2 500 DA").

MyListingCounts.description: The member's listings by status, whatever the `status` filter: the tab counters.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page. Null on the last page.

total.description: Number of items across all pages, with the `status` filter.

type.description: What happened, such as `ORDER_SHIPPED`, `NEW_OFFER` or `NEW_FOLLOWER`: the `type` its push carried too. For an icon; new types appear without notice, so give an unknown one a generic icon.

text.description: The sentence to show, in the response language.

url.description: The website page it is about: route it like an app link (see the API guide). Null: there is nothing to open.

NotificationItem.description: One entry of the notifications screen.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page. Null on the last page.

total.description: Number of items across all pages.

NotificationPage.description: A page of notifications, newest first.

upTo.description: The `id` of the newest notification on screen: it and every older one are marked read. One that arrived since stays unread, unless it is one the list leaves out.

amount.description: Offered price: for the item, or for the whole bundle. Integer DZD.

expiresAt.description: A pending offer lapses at this time. ISO 8601, UTC.

createdAt.description: When it was made. ISO 8601, UTC.

sentBy.description: `BUYER` for a buyer's offer, `SELLER` for a price the seller proposed.

listingId.description: The listing. For a bundle offer, the bundle's first item.

bundle.description: Set when the offer prices a whole bundle.

canAccept.description: The signed-in member can accept it: it waits for their answer, the conversation takes replies, and the goods are still for sale.

canCancel.description: The signed-in member made it and it still waits for an answer.

conversationId.description: Where the negotiation happens. An offer on a listing or a bundle opens it if needed.

offer.description: The offer just made (for a counter-offer, the new one), or the one just answered, as it stands now.

messages.description: What the action posted in the conversation, oldest first. Add them to the thread right away: the live stream may deliver them again, merge by `id`.

amount.description: Integer DZD, within the offer range (`offerRange`, or `counterRange` for a counter-offer).

min.description: Lowest amount accepted: 30% of the asking price, and never under 100 DZD. Integer Algerian dinars (DZD).

max.description: Highest amount accepted: the asking price. Integer Algerian dinars (DZD).

awaitingArrival.description: Buyer: the parcel is on its way. Show "Confirm receipt" disabled, with "Available once the parcel has arrived".

canRespondToDispute.description: Seller: the dispute waits for their answer (`POST /disputes/{id}/respond`).

canReview.description: "Leave a review" (`POST /orders/{id}/review`): the order is completed and the signed-in member has not reviewed it.

itemPrice.description: The items: their price, or the accepted offer's amount. Integer DZD.

protectionFee.description: Platform and service fee. Integer DZD.

discount.description: Promo code and referral voucher, both paid by Taleed: the seller's earnings stay whole. Integer DZD.

total.description: What the buyer pays: `itemPrice` + `protectionFee` + `shippingFee` − `discount`. Integer DZD.

walletApplied.description: Part of `total` the buyer paid from their wallet. Integer DZD.

amountDue.description: The rest, paid online or in cash: `total` − `walletApplied`. Integer DZD.

sellerEarns.description: What the seller receives once the order is completed: `itemPrice`. Integer DZD.

listingId.description: The listing to buy. Send it or `bundleId`.

carrierEvents.description: Every scan the carrier reported, newest first. They explain a parcel that seems stuck; the steps tell the story, so fold these away.

myReview.description: The review the signed-in member left on this order.

reviewReceived.description: The review the other side left about the signed-in member.

replayed.description: A retry with a `clientId` already used: the order placed the first time, with its payment page if it still waits for payment.

OrderStatus.description: Where an order stands. `PENDING_PAYMENT`: placed, the goods are reserved until the online payment lands. `PAID`: paid, or confirmed for cash on delivery: the seller ships. `PREPARED`: the parcel and its label exist, the seller drops it off. `SHIPPED`: with the carrier. `DELIVERED`: delivered; the payment is released to the seller at `autoCompleteAt` unless the buyer confirms or reports a problem first. `COMPLETED`: the seller was paid. `CANCELLED`: called off before any money moved, or given back. `REFUNDED`: the buyer was refunded. `DISPUTED`: a dispute froze the payment. label.description: In the response language. `ARRIVED` reads "Arrived at the pickup desk" or "Out for delivery", depending on the delivery.

done.description: Passed. The carrier can skip statuses: a step with no date of its own counts as passed once a later one is.

OrderStep.description: A step of the order timeline.

OrderStepKey.description: A milestone of an order. `PAID`: the payment is received and held. `PREPARED`: the shipping label exists. `SHIPPED`: the carrier has the parcel. `ARRIVED`: at the buyer's pick-up point, or out for delivery. `DELIVERED`: delivered. `COMPLETED`: the payment was released to the seller.

termsUrl.description: The program's terms, on the website.
